desc:
🍖 THROW FOOD FOR HORROR! 🍖
Throw food, lure SCP's and build the ultimate collection!

🎯 Time your throw and hit PERFECT for extra power
🏋️ Train on your bench press to gain Throw Power
🌍 Throw farther and reach 11 different worlds

🐾 Collect 88 mobs, from tiny creatures to giant bosses
🎬 Watch every mob make its own epic entrance
💰 Place mobs on your plot and earn cash, even while offline

📖 Complete the Index to claim cash and power rewards
🎁 Collect Daily Rewards that grow with your progress

Can you catch them all? 👀
